key.name: launcher
key.description: Which home screen the home gesture opens: Phosh's own app grid or the VibeOS launcher. Read by a Phosh patched to offer the choice.

key.name: desktop-grid-columns
key.description: The home screen grid's columns. VibeOS Settings offers 4 × 5, 4 × 6, 5 × 5 and 5 × 6 (columns × rows; Launcher3's 5 × 5 is the default); icons a smaller grid has no cell for move to the next free one.

key.name: desktop-icon-scale
key.description: The home screen's and the dock's icons, as a share of Launcher3's 56 dp; never larger than their cells leave room for.

key.name: drawer-icon-scale
key.description: The app drawer's icons, as a share of 56 dp; never larger than its columns leave room for.

key.name: home-widgets
key.description: The weather and an analog clock across the top two rows of the first page.

key.name: desktop-hide-app-labels
key.summary: Hide labels on the home screen

key.name: icon-pack
key.description: Directory name of an icon pack under vibeos-launcher/iconpacks in the user's data dir (~/.local/share) or a system one (/usr/local/share, /usr/share): pack.json, gnome-map.json, icons/. Empty: the theme's icons.

key.name: icon-wrap-unthemed
key.summary: Wrap icons the pack does not cover in its own background

key.name: icon-shape-legacy
key.summary: Draw icons without pack art on a shaped background

key.name: search-drawer-enabled
key.summary: Search field at the top of the app drawer
key.description: Off: no search pill, and the app list starts where it was.

key.name: hidden-from-home
key.summary: Apps removed from the home screen (still in the drawer)

key.name: wallpaper-parallax
key.description: A directory with parallax.json and its layer pictures (back to front); the layers shift by their depth as the phone tilts. Empty: the GNOME wallpaper, still.

key.name: lock-type
key.description: pin: Phosh's keypad. pattern: a 3x3 dot grid on the lock screen, the dots in order are the password. swipe: no password (Phosh's require-unlock off).

key.name: double-tap-wake
key.description: While the screen is off the touchscreen waits in its low power mode for a double tap, which wakes the screen.

key.name: power-double-press-app
key.description: The app (a desktop file id) that a second press of the power key within 300 ms of the first opens, waking the screen; a locked phone asks for the unlock first. Empty: off, and the key only turns the screen off and on. An app that is not installed counts as off.

key.name: power-hold-agent
key.description: On: holding the power key for half a second has Agent listen until the key is let go (on a locked phone Agent only reads until the phone is unlocked), and the power menu is the power key and volume up together. Off: holding the power key opens the power menu, as it did before. Without the Agent app installed, holding the key opens the power menu.

key.name: side-key-app
key.description: What a press of the side button (a key that reports KEY_APPSELECT, such as a button of its own under the volume keys) does with the screen on: 'recents' opens recent apps, a desktop file id opens that app (a locked phone asks for the unlock first), empty does nothing. An app that is not installed opens recent apps.

key.name: aod
key.description: When the screen goes off, the panel stays on, black, with the time, the date, the battery and the apps with notifications in dim grey.

key.name: keyboard
key.description: gnome: GNOME Shell's own keyboard. vibeos: the AOSP keyboard's layouts, sizes and colours, for the phone and the tablet.

key.name: keyboard-suggestions
key.description: The VibeOS keyboard's strip shows words for the one being typed (LatinIME's "Show correction suggestions").

key.name: keyboard-autocorrect
key.description: Spacebar and punctuation automatically correct mistyped words (teh: the); backspace right after takes the correction back.

key.name: keyboard-next-word
key.description: Between words the strip suggests the next one, from the words typed before and the language's commonest pairs (LatinIME's "Use previous word in making suggestions").

key.name: keyboard-slide-apps
key.description: App ids (desktop file names without .desktop) whose window keeps its size when the on-screen keyboard comes up: it slides up just far enough to keep the text cursor's line above the keys, and back down when they close. For terminals, whose text is reflowed when the window is resized. Other apps' windows are fitted above the keys. An app can ask for this itself with X-Vibeos-Keyboard=slide in its desktop file.
